name: Meeting Mode
author: Jim Burchel; nixarchy port by Olaf K. Freund
description: Join any call and your desktop goes quiet by itself: Do Not Disturb, no idle lock, night light off, voice control paused. Hang up and it all comes back. Works with Meet, Zoom, Teams, Slack and Discord, in the browser or the app.

barWidget.description: Lights up while you're in a call. Click to turn meeting mode on or off, right-click for settings.
